info.headline: Flood Warning for Mary River downstream of Gympie, Mary River at Miva and Mary River at Tiaro
info.description:
Flooding is no longer expected along the Mary River downstream of Gympie.
The Mary River at Miva is currently at 3.11 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Mary River at Miva is expected to remain below the minor flood level (7.50 m).
The Mary River at Tiaro is currently at 3.14 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Mary River at Tiaro is expected to remain below the minor flood level (6.00 m).
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
